ns2:course.label: Advertising History
ns2:course.description: Teaches the important events, forces, people, and technologies that helped advertising to become an important institution in America. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 300.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
